authority_note: Single source of truth for standard-value audit adjudication. skill.md, sidecar prompt.ts, standard_value_audit_judge_v1.md, standard_value_audit_result.schema.json and the defect manifest must derive from this file.

verdicts.match: 声称值不违反适用标准要求（检索后）
verdicts.mismatch: 声称值与适用标准要求冲突（检索后）
verdicts.unevaluable: 该审，但证据不足以下结论（检索后）
verdicts.out_of_scope: 声称值不构成限值声称，无需检索即可判（检索前）

flags.tighter_than_standard: 声称值严于标准限值；提示自行加严，不计入缺陷
flags.basis_edition_mismatch: 报告声明的标准版次与知识库现行版次不一致
flags.basis_incomplete: 报告检测依据中的标准未在知识库全部命中

predicate_fields.source: relation / tightness from audit_semantics.compare_claims; unit_state from audit_semantics.normalize_unit_pair

rules.name: value_relation_decides_verdict

then.verdict: match when relation in (equal, supports); mismatch when relation in (conflicts, different)
then.kind: exact for match unless C-01/C-02/C-03/C-08/C-11 refines it; mismatch subtype by kind_priority

rules.rationale: 基础规则。v1 初稿只写了例外情形，没有写「相等就是 match」这个平凡情形，导致 derive 在最常见的路径上输出空 rules，而空 rules 按 derivation_contract 是无效判定。

rules.name: tighter_than_standard_is_compliant
rules.rationale: 审查回答的是报告是否违反标准；加严不违反。判 mismatch 会在真实报告上产生大量误报并污染 mismatch 信号。

rules.name: unit_equivalence
rules.rationale: 单位表述差异不是内容差异；仅当换算后仍不一致才进入 mismatch。
rules.requires: evidence must state the conversion relation

rules.name: total_loss_formula_aggregate

decision_by_claim_role.limit_claim: the aggregate of the no-load and load-loss limits is the standard bound; ordinary bound semantics apply, so a stricter total-loss limit is match/within_standard under C-01
decision_by_claim_role.reported_aggregate: a reported total verified against its own reported addends requires equality; any difference is mismatch/formula_aggregate

rules.rationale: GB/T 1094.1 第3.6.4条定义总损耗=空载+负载，但限值表无独立总损耗列。
rules.amended_in_v1_draft: 初稿写「≠加和即 mismatch（无论偏大偏小）」，把「限值声称」和「实测值算术一致性」混为一体；报告自行声称 ≤2.400 kW 而标准加和为 3.205 kW 时属于自行加严，不是缺陷。
rules.forbids: comparing a total-loss claim against a single load-loss limit

rules.name: display_precision_is_exact
rules.rationale: 60 与 60.0、35 与 35.0 是同一要求；v7 未定义此情形会导致误报。

rules.name: qualitative_clause_out_of_scope

placeholder_values.note: a placeholder in the reported requirement column states no limit, so it is out_of_scope; reading it as a categorical label produces false wrong_label defects

rules.rationale: 修复四向判定退化成三向：实测 40 case 中模型一次都未输出 not_audited，gate 遵从 0/7。拒判交给模型，模型不会用。
example_forms: 试验电压应不出现突然下降
波形图比较应无明显差异

rules.name: standard_priority_order

then.immaterial_conflict: when every conflicting basis yields the same relation to the claim, the conflict cannot change the verdict and must not block adjudication; record note basis_conflict_immaterial

rules.rationale: judge_v1 将优先级交给模型，而 EVALUATION_REPORT 自行将 hbjc-13-r4 的唯一失败归因为「标准优先级未定义」。这是业务裁定权。

rules.name: basis_edition_and_completeness
rules.must_not: raise and abort the audit run
rules.rationale: 报告引用作废或错误版次标准是一条真实审查发现，现实现把它变成了一次任务失败。

rules.name: interval_and_tolerance_algebra

disjoint.kind: by kind_priority on the band centers

center_first.applies_when: both sides are tolerance bands around a nominal (forms relative_symmetric / absolute_symmetric)
order: compare the nominal centers first; a center difference beyond display tolerance is a value error, kind by kind_priority (magnitude_error or numeric_looser), never bandwidth_exceeded
only when the centers agree does band width decide: wider reported band -> mismatch/bandwidth_exceeded, narrower -> match/exact + tighter_than_standard
center_first.rationale: 报告写 -76(1±3%) 而标准是 75(1±3%) 时，错的是标尼值不是带宽；初稿表会把它归成 bandwidth_exceeded，与 crosswalk 里 different -> wrong_condition|numeric_looser 自相矛盾。

polarity.rule: compare magnitudes when one side carries a signed nominal and the other is unsigned and the comparator is exact or a tolerance band
polarity.rationale: 冲击电压 -75 kV 与标准表的 75 kV 是同一要求；极性差异不是内容差异。

comparator_direction_first.rule: resolve comparator direction across the two sides before containment; a degenerate standard scalar inherits the reported bound direction, exactly as the scalar path does
comparator_direction_first.rationale: 标准事实常只记录了限值数字（如 0.80）而 operator 为 eq；不先对齐方向会把退化区间 [0.8, 0.8] 与 [−∞, 0.234] 判为 disjoint。

standard_tolerance_not_recorded.rule: when the reported side expands a base by a relative tolerance and that base equals the recorded standard value while the standard fact records no tolerance of its own, the case is unevaluable/applicability_undetermined
standard_tolerance_not_recorded.rationale: 报告写 ≤0.18(1+30%) 而标准事实只记了 0.18：无法分辨报告是在引用标准自己的 +30% 容差，还是自行放宽了 30%。判 mismatch 是猜。
standard_tolerance_not_recorded.resolution: extract the tolerance into the standard fact, then this clause stops firing

rules.rationale: 实测 73 case 中 13 条（18%）因区间/容差表达式未被解析器支持而退回 LLM；这些是最规范的容差写法。

rules.name: applicability_undetermined
rules.forbids: filling applicability with industry common sense (通常/一般/常见/大概率)

rules.name: standard_not_found_with_gate
admission_gate: at least 2 distinct query formulations (standard_no / project_name / parameter_name)
full-text read of the most relevant hit (search returns truncated preview only)
reasoning must list attempted queries and read chunks
rules.enforced_by: host-side hard gate with one re-judge reprompt
rules.rationale: v6 教训：case 13-r4 检索 9 次但 0 次读全文就宣布条款不存在。

rules.name: categorical_label_comparison
rules.rationale: 联结组标号这类分类值是真实审查对象，但 v1 初稿没有任何规则会产出 wrong_label，kind 表里却列了它。
rules.must_not: decide membership when the standard side is a concatenation such as 'Dyn11Yyn0'; a concatenated cell means the extraction lost the label boundaries and must be split before scoring

rules.name: verbatim_requirement_quote
rules.rationale: 很多报告直接抄录标准原文，如「规定电压比的±0.5%与实际阻抗电压百分数的±1/10 中较低者」。双方字符串相同时无需解析即可判定；初稿把这类 case 归为解析失败。
rules.normalization: compare after markup stripping, full-width folding, whitespace removal and case folding

removed_from_v7.reason: 加严改判 match + within_standard + flag tighter_than_standard

blocking_precondition.current_state: false for all 611 cases; tmp/transformer-intake-20260907/ no longer exists
blocking_precondition.consequence: no case in transformer_reports_v2/gold.json may be scored until the 7 source files are re-archived and verified against reports.json sha256

derivation_contract.function: derive(reported_requirement, real, conditions, caliber_v1) -> {verdict, kind, flags[], scoreable, derivation}

crosswalk.migration_note: verdict and kind should become first-class fields end to end; the sidecar currently maps verdict back to the legacy vocabulary and kind is dropped on the read side, which discards the primary audit output (which error, not merely that there is one).

defect_edit_kind.note: All 19 existing labels are already consistent with caliber v1; no gold edits needed. The conflicting side is skill.md / prompt.ts rule 6.

on_caliber_change: write a new caliber_vN.md + caliber_vN.json; never edit a released version
re-run derive over all gold and emit caliber_vPREV_to_vN_diff.json
human confirmation of the diff before switching the active version
every evaluation result must record the caliber_version it was scored under
change_policy.forbidden: manual per-case gold relabeling; fix the rule, not the label
